International master's fee examples for 2027 entry

Royal Holloway: £25,500 (MSc Information and Cyber Security)
Loughborough: £27,000 (MSc Intl Business Management, September)
Exeter: £30,100 (MSc Computer Science, September)
Lancaster: £30,900 (MSc Intl Business and Strategic Mgmt)
Bristol: £34,500 (MSc Management (International Business))
Nottingham: £34,800 (MSc International Business)
Manchester: £35,300 (MSc Economics)

Single-program examples. Other subjects at the same university charge different fees. On a Turkish passport, this international fee applies.

Source: royalholloway.ac.uk, lboro.ac.uk, exeter.ac.uk, lancaster.ac.uk, bristol.ac.uk, nottingham.ac.uk, manchester.ac.uk (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Twente's TOEFL threshold rises from September 2027

Master's: IELTS 6.5 (each section 6.0). TOEFL: 90 or 4.5 on the new scale for February 2027 entry; 100 or 5 from September 2027. The non-EU master's fee for 2027/28 ranges from €18,720 to €22,320 by program.

Source: utwente.nl (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
“TOEFL is still scored out of 120”

The truth: The scale changed: now from 1 to 6. TOEFL iBT taken after 21 January 2026 is reported on a 1-6 band. Band 5 equals 95-106 on the old scale. New thresholds: Berkeley 4.5, Caltech 5.

Source: ets.org, admissions.berkeley.edu, admissions.caltech.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
